visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a woman in a blue baseball cap and white t-shirt sitting inside a train carriage. She looks nauseous and dizzy, slumped over a wooden box. The setting is a modern train interior with warm lighting and red upholstery. This scene is contrasted with a black steam-style train at a platform where a man waves. (2) The interior of the luxury train is showcased, featuring plush green private booths and expansive windows overlooking the Japanese countryside. A man sits at a table with a wooden bento box, representing the 'ideal' travel experience. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from the large windows. (3) The woman is shown again in the 'reality' segment, looking exhausted as the camera captures the intense vibration of the train. A young boy in a green shirt and sunglasses appears, shouting and being energetic. They are surrounded by multiple wooden bento boxes on a table. (4) Close-up shots focus on the food, which consists of a variety of colorful dishes in a multi-compartment wooden box, including rice and vegetables. The woman points at a cup of tea that is visibly shaking due to the train's motion. The camera movement is handheld and slightly shaky. (5) In a different part of the train, the woman and the child stand at a long wooden souvenir counter. They examine various train-related items like keychains. The child wears dark sunglasses. They then move to a stamping station where they press a large ink stamp onto a commemorative postcard. (6) The video concludes with a close-up of the child clapping his hands in celebration after successfully stamping the card. The woman holds up the completed postcard, which features a colorful circular logo of the 'Ichiroku' train service.
